meta.title: Ressy — A full calendar, zero no-shows
meta.description: Streamline your service business with Ressy: your own booking page, automatic WhatsApp reminders, and upfront deposits. Any timezone, any currency. Set up free in 10 minutes.

hero.title: A full calendar. Zero no-shows.
hero.subtitle: Ressy gives your business its own booking page, automatic WhatsApp reminders, and upfront payments. Set up in 10 minutes, free.
hero.micro: No credit card · Free plan forever

items.title: Reminders that actually work

items.body: Secure every booking with an upfront payment.

items.title: Your page, your brand
items.body: Your own link, your colors, your logo.

items.title: Your whole team's schedule
items.body: Every pro, every shift, one calendar.

items.title: Know your clients
items.body: History, notes, and who keeps missing appointments.

items.title: Clear numbers
items.body: Revenue, occupancy, and top services at a glance.

items.quote: I cut no-shows from 8 to 1 a week. The reminders alone pay for the plan.
items.name: Camila R.

items.quote: My clients book at night from Instagram. I used to lose all those appointments.
items.name: Valentina P.

items.quote: It took me 10 minutes to set up. Seriously.
items.name: Diego S.

items.q: Do my clients need an account?
items.a: No. They book as guests in a few taps — no sign-up, no downloads.
Yes, via Stripe or Mercado Pago depending on your country. You set the amount or percentage.

items.q: Does it work in my country?
items.a: Yes: any timezone and currency. Ressy is worldwide from day one.
Yes, upgrade or downgrade anytime — no lock-in.

items.q: What if I outgrow the Free plan?
items.a: We'll let you know first; you never lose your bookings.

items.q: Does it sync with Google Calendar?
items.a: Yes, two-way: what you book in Ressy shows in Google and vice versa.
